_comment: Removed a fabricated STATIC_TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND -> INTIMIDATE ability: the card has no intimidate text. The generator hallucinated it from Blade Break equipment (27 cards corpus-wide). Triggered on START_OF_TURN with a NOT-active-player condition, and START_OF_TURN is dispatched only to the TURN PLAYER's permanents -- so the event never arrived and the condition was never even evaluated. Now START_OF_ANY_TURN, which reaches both players' permanents.
